history.observed: 1951 — Ewen & Purcell; Muller & Oort; Christiansen et al.

T_star.note: transition energy expressed as a temperature; T_* << T_S in all plausible astrophysical settings

einstein_A.note: spontaneous transition probability; literature range 2.85e-15 to 2.9e-15 s^-1 across sources — adopted value from the vdhulst HI notes; the ~11-million-year mean lifetime is why the line is collisionally pumped in the ISM

frequency.note: Hz = s^-1; the second is anchored to the Cs-133 hyperfine transition per SI-DIMLESS-01

photon_energy.note: E = h*nu; kilogram anchored by fixing h

wavelength.note: 21.106114054160 cm in vacuum; meter anchored via c and the second

anchor.transition: ground-state (1s) hyperfine spin-flip, F=1 -> F=0 (electron spin reversed relative to proton spin)

chirality_readout.mechanism: in a magnetic field the line splits into Zeeman components; the sigma+ and sigma- components are circularly polarized with opposite handedness
chirality_readout.observable: handedness of the Zeeman sigma components of the 21 cm line
chirality_readout.rule: the assigned handedness of each sigma component reverses with the sign of B_los
chirality_readout.scope_note: this is the chirality-sensitive observable built on the anchor; the bare line frequency itself carries no handedness
chirality_readout.status: standard radio-astronomical technique for measuring interstellar magnetic fields

quantity_object_shape.unit_vector: {m: int, kg: int, s: int, A: int, K: int, mol: int, cd: int}

dimensionless_representation.ratio_rule: dimensionless_ratio := Q / Q_ref where Q_ref has the same unit_vector and is explicitly declared

principle: The C-1 physics-interface import is calibrated against the measured 21 cm hyperfine line of neutral hydrogen. The line anchors scale (frequency, wavelength, time) as dimensionless ratios against explicitly declared references; orientation content is carried separately by the sector assignment (CHIRAL-ANCHOR-02). A frequency standard is a scalar: it does not by itself break orientation.
references: Hydrogen line — Wikipedia (frequency 1420.405751768(2) MHz; wavelength 21.106114054160(30) cm; photon energy 5.8743261841116(81) ueV = 9.411708152678(13)e-25 J)
vdhulst HI physics notes (A_10 = 2.86888e-15 s^-1; nu_10 = 1.420405751786(30) GHz)

scope.does_not_establish: orientation breaking by itself — the bare line is a scalar standard; the orientation content is the sector occupancy in CHIRAL-ANCHOR-02
scope.establishes: scale calibration for the C-1 bridge equations; a chirality-sensitive readout (Zeeman sigma handedness) on the same anchor

title: 21 cm Neutral-Hydrogen Hyperfine Line as Empirical P0 Anchor (C-1 Calibration)

numerical_root.directive: all numerical values in the calibration program are driven off this anchor (Kit, 2026-09-28)
numerical_root.status: ASSERTED-by-Kit (directive); the anchor values themselves are empirical (measured)

precision_hierarchy.lambda_21: c/nu_21, c exact (SI 2019) — inherits nu_21's 1.4e-12 exactly
precision_hierarchy.E_21: h*nu_21, h exact (SI 2019) — inherits nu_21's 1.4e-12 exactly
precision_hierarchy.A_10: theoretical (2.86888e-15 s^-1); less precise — rate quantities routed through A_10 carry its larger uncertainty

metrological_chain.principle: every physical quantity Q = (dimensionless theory ratio) x (power of anchor ratio) x (anchor quantity); the theory supplies dimensionless numbers, Kit supplies two dimensionless ratios, the anchor supplies all SI values

unknown_ratios.rho_E: mc^2/E_21 — system rest energy in anchor units (Kit's call; open slot)
unknown_ratios.rho_V: V_min/lambda_21^3 — minimum volume in anchor units (Kit's call; open slot)

metrological_chain.rate: r = (r/nu_21) * nu_21  [via A_10 only where spontaneous-emission physics enters]
